limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
No MessageSet byte sequence was crafted, parsed or executed; the finding is static.
The advisory, CVE and NVD records do not name a fix commit; b4c395a was located in upstream history between v3.20.1 and v3.20.2 and proven by ancestry, not by an advisory reference.
Only the 3.20.x line is verified. The CNA also lists 3.18.x, 3.19.x, 3.21.x and 4.21.x fixes and OSV lists four PyPI ranges; neither their commits nor their release contents were reviewed here.
The exact byte pattern that maximizes memory growth is not demonstrated. The static claim is limited to the absent state machine and the duplicate-tag handling shown by the fix.
OSV covers the PyPI package only; the C++ library has no OSV ecosystem record. The dossier therefore declares a generic protobuf-cpp range from CNA/NVD, not an OSV range.
CWE-119 appears only in OSV database_specific; the CNA and NVD primary mapping is CWE-1286. CWE-119 is recorded as an additional mapping, not as the canonical CWE.

critical_operation.description: The free template function google::protobuf::internal::ParseMessageSetItemImpl (not a WireFormatLite member) tracks MessageSet progress with two sentinel values rather than a state machine. last_type_id == 0 means 'no type id seen', and message_data.empty() means 'no buffered payload'; a real type id of 0 is indistinguishable from 'unset'. Message tags are either buffered when last_type_id is 0 or parsed immediately into the extension when it is non-zero. The parser never records that a type id/payload pair was already completed, so duplicate type-id and duplicate message tags in one MessageSetItem are accepted and the same logical field is parsed or merged repeatedly instead of being rejected or skipped. The fix replaces the sentinels with enum class State { kNoTag, kHasType, kHasPayload, kDone } and, in the terminal state, skips duplicate payload bytes instead of re-parsing them. The same design appears in WireFormat::MessageSetParser (wire_format.cc) and ExtensionSet::ParseMessageSetItemTmpl (extension_set_inl.h); the fix patches all three.

entry_point.description: WireFormat::ParseAndMergeMessageSetItem is the reflective entry point reached from WireFormat::ParseAndMerge when a field is a MessageSet item; it forwards directly to the lite parser above. No application-level validation sits between the wire bytes and this switch.

source_crosscheck.notes: CNA and NVD agree on the 3.20.x range. The CNA records CWE-1286; NVD lists NVD-CWE-Other as its own primary weakness and CWE-1286 in a secondary (Google-sourced) entry; OSV metadata lists CWE-119 and CWE-1286. The canonical cwe_ids keep CWE-1286 as primary and CWE-119 as an additional mapping, while the NVD-CWE-Other entry is recorded here rather than mapped to a concrete CWE. CNA metrics.other records 5.7 MEDIUM with AV:A/PR:L, while NVD primary and OSV record 7.5 HIGH with AV:N/PR:N; the canonical severity uses NVD primary 7.5 and keeps the CNA 5.7 as an alternate score. No source names a fix commit; the fix was found in upstream history and is recorded with ancestry proof. OSV only models the PyPI package and lists four ranges; this dossier verifies only the C++ 3.20.x range and does not import PyPI ranges into the C++ declaration.
